text: Experts believe that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) could change our world completely. Unlike today's AI, which focuses on specific tasks, AGI would understand and learn like a human. It could solve major problems, such as diseases and climate change. However, there are serious risks. AGI might be difficult to control, and some people worry it could take jobs or even become dangerous. Scientists disagree about when AGI will arrive. Some predict it within twenty years, while others think it is much further away. Because of this uncertainty, many experts say we should develop AI carefully and safely.
